title: Bear Dash Runner
description: Help an energetic little bear race across scenic forest bridges—bounce off mushrooms, collect sweet honey jars, and outrun mischievous bees.
controls: Tap to jump over logs and gaps while grabbing honey jars and speed boosts along the trail.

zh-CN.title: 小熊快跑
zh-CN.description: 治愈卡通横版跑酷小熊快跑：陪萌萌小熊在阳光森林一路狂奔跳跃，狂吃蜂蜜罐躲避障碍停不下来！
zh-CN.controls: 点击屏幕控制小熊跳跃闪避森林路障，收集香甜蜂蜜刷新跑酷得分。
